records.text: Candace Owens said Kash Patel removed the prior head of the FBI Salt Lake City office and installed Robert Bohls, who assumed the role on September 2, eight days before Charlie Kirk's assassination.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And then this one, which just gets me. Remember Special Agent Robert Bohls, who had been serving for the FBI office over in Virginia, but suddenly and rather inexplicably, Kash Patel fires the person that was heading up— ... —the FBI Salt Lake City office. He fires that person and installs Robert Bohls. On September 2nd, okay, eight days before the Charlie Kirk assassination, Robert Bohls assumes that position at the Salt Lake field office.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms Salt Lake City SAC Mehtab Syed was forced out in August 2025 and Robert Bohls replaced her shortly before Kirk's September 10 killing; the FBI confirms Bohls as SAC. The reviewed authoritative sources did not establish an exact September 2 assumption date or that Patel personally installed Bohls, so the compound claim is only partially verified.
